capabilities: Render SMILES code blocks as chemical structure images in live preview and read mode
Choose output image format (PNG or SVG) and width in settings
Configure the Ketcher + Indigo rendering server, including a self-hosted one
extras: Warns against enabling it alongside Obsidian-Chem because both transform 'smiles' code blocks. Uses an EPAM-hosted server by default, so structure data is sent to an external service; the self-hosting tutorial is still in progress.
intentEvidence: Due to overlapping functionalities, please be aware that this plugin may conflict with the Obsidian-Chem plugin
problem: Obsidian cannot visualize chemical compounds written in SMILES notation inside notes.

relations.evidence: empowered by Ketcher, Indigo, and inspired by Obsidian-Chem
